metadata.description: FlowSync is a SaaS startup founded in April 2024, dedicated to empowering SMBs to automate cross-app workflows without code. With intuitive drag-and-drop tools and deep integrations, FlowSync helps businesses save time, reduce errors, and scale operations seamlessly. The platform has gained early traction among marketing agencies and e-commerce companies.

roadmap.narrative_description: Launch of the 'Conditional Logic' feature, allowing users to build more intelligent automation workflows based on triggers and data variables. This update is anticipated to drive greater user engagement and expand use cases.
Secured and onboarded FlowSync's first enterprise client, marking a significant step toward upmarket expansion and validating the platform's scalability.
Began the process of obtaining ISO 27001 certification to strengthen FlowSync’s security posture and meet enterprise compliance requirements.
Reached 2,000 active user accounts, reflecting sustained organic growth and the success of targeted marketing campaigns.
Closed a $2M seed funding round led by a prominent SaaS-focused VC, securing capital for product development and team expansion.

roadmap.milestone_title: Hiring: Engineering & Customer Success Teams Expanded
roadmap.narrative_description: Onboarded five new team members in engineering and customer success, boosting product velocity and improving user support.
Released FlowSync's public API in beta, enabling third-party developers and partners to build custom integrations and extending the ecosystem.

roadmap.milestone_title: Q4 Customer Satisfaction Survey & NPS Improvement
roadmap.narrative_description: Conducted the quarterly customer satisfaction survey, with Net Promoter Score rising from 40 to 52, reflecting improved onboarding and support.
Successfully completed ISO 27001 certification, enabling FlowSync to confidently pursue larger enterprise contracts.
Announced a strategic partnership with a leading e-commerce platform, unlocking new customer acquisition channels and integration opportunities.
Launched the MVP version of FlowSync’s mobile app, allowing users to monitor workflows and receive notifications on the go.
FlowSync surpasses $500K in annual recurring revenue, a major financial milestone reflecting healthy SaaS metrics and positioning the company for future growth.
